reviews.author: Milagros C…
reviews.body: ¡Yari es increíble! Además de ser súper amable y cordial, tiene muchísimo talento. Me dejó las uñas espectaculares y quedé feliz con el resultado. La recomiendo al 100%.

reviews.author: Brianna P…
reviews.body:
I cannot recommend my Yari enough! Every appointment is such a great experience from start to finish. Not only is she incredibly talented and detail-oriented, but she truly takes the time to make sure every set is perfect. My nails always come out beautiful, last for weeks, and get so many compliments.

She is professional, welcoming, and creates such a comfortable atmosphere. You can tell she genuinely cares about her clients and takes pride in her work. Whether I come in with a specific design in mind or need help deciding, she always exceeds my expectations.

If you’re looking for someone who is talented, reliable, and passionate about what she does, she is the one to go to. Thank you for always making me feel confident and leaving me with nails I absolutely love!
